tone_statements.citation: Ndao, Dame. 2015. La relative en pepel. Afrikanistik-Aegyptologie-Online (AAeO), Ausgabe 2015 (Rubrik Artikel), 13 pp. Köln: Universitäts- und Stadtbibliothek Köln / hbz. doi:10.18716/ojs/aaeo/2015_3422; urn:nbn:de:0009-10-41499.
tone_statements.quote: Le pepel comporte 43 phonèmes répartis en 25 consonnes dont 7 prénasales et 18 voyelles (dont 10 brèves, 5 longues et 3 prénasales). La langue ne comporte pas de ton mais se caractérise par la présence d’un accent tonique qui tombe sur la voyelle de la première syllabe du lexème2.
tone_statements.translation: Pepel has 43 phonemes, divided into 25 consonants (7 of them prenasalised) and 18 vowels (10 short, 5 long and 3 prenasalised). The language has no tone but is characterised by the presence of a stress accent that falls on the vowel of the first syllable of the lexeme [fn. 2: for detailed information see Ndao (2013), Phonologie, morphologie et structures syntaxiques du pepel].
tone_statements.locator: sec. 2 'Propriétés typologiques de la langue', paragraph <3>, p. 2 of; the trailing '2' in the quote is the call to footnote 2 (= cf. Ndao 2013)
tone_statements.summary: No lexical tone; fixed word stress on the first syllable of the lexeme (author's summary of her own 2011/2013 phonology of Pepel, Biombo dialect).

sources.citation: Ndao, Dame. 2015. Les classes nominales en pepel. Linguistica Atlantica 34(1): 29-43 (open access, UNB Libraries OJS).
sources.note: Sec. 2 'Quelques données préalables sur la phonologie du pepel' (pp. 30-31) summarises Ndao 2011: consonant table, 10 vowel qualities with +/-ATR and no vowel harmony, prenasals as morphological; nothing whatever on stress, accent or tone (the only 'accent' hits are 'l'accent est mis sur..'). Rest of the article is noun-class morphology.

sources.citation: Ié, Ivo Aloide. 2022. Marcação de plural: um estudo semântico de classe nominal do pepel. MA dissertation, Universidade de São Paulo (FFLCH), 83 ff. doi:10.11606/d.8.2022.tde-20092022-183926.
sources.note: No phonology chapter and no mention of stress/accent/tone anywhere (a full-text search for stress/accent acento/tônic/tom/tonal/prosód/sílaba: zero hits). Useful only as a bibliography: sec. 2.7 'Estudos anteriores' (pp. 33-34) states that only four works on Pepel exist: Marques 1947, Mané 2004, Ndao 2011, Ndao 2015. archived copy (Internet Archive, 22 Oct 2025) because teses.usp.br refused connections by automated download.

sources.note: The typological preamble (sec. 2 'Propriétés typologiques de la langue', par. <3>) states that Pepel has 43 phonemes, no tone, and a stress accent ('accent tonique') falling on the vowel of the first syllable of the lexeme, referring for detail (fn. 2) to Ndao 2013 Phonologie, morphologie et structures syntaxiques du pepel. The rest of the article is relative-clause syntax; examples carry no tone marks.
